subject: Ariba onboarding: Order Form PO-field mapping & legal review queue
messages:
From: Ava Simmons <ava.simmons@novushealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement-ops@novushealth.com
Date: 2027-04-25 09:12 -0700
Subject: Ariba onboarding — PO field clarifications before signature

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. We're starting our final technical review for Ariba enrollment and one of our engineers flagged a mismatch between the PO 'bill_to' and 'invoice_to' fields for line-level invoicing. Before we sign the order form, can you confirm: 

- Whether Redwood's order form requires "bill_to" at the line level or at the header only.
- Any SLAs that change if we enable line-level invoicing (we expect different acknowledgement behavior).

I've attached the RFQ spreadsheet with our expected PO schema. If this is a legal issue, please route to your counsel; we'd like to avoid doing a second pass after execution.

Best,
Ava Simmons
Sr. Procurement Manager
Novus Health

Attachment: RFQ_Ariba_PO_Field_Spec_0425.xlsx

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Ava Simmons <ava.simmons@novushealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-25 10:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Ariba onboarding — PO field clarifications before signature

Hi Ava — thanks for the spec. Quick summary and next steps below.

Summary:
- Our standard Order Form supports header-level "bill_to"/"ship_to" and line-level "invoice_to" is available as an optional flag (we treat line-level invoicing as a different ingestion path).
- Enabling line-level invoicing may require a short acknowledgement SLA change (it can add up to ~300ms per PO during validation under heavy batch loads).

Next steps I propose:
1) Jordan: can legal confirm if the current Order Form language covers optional line-level invoicing as a configuration toggle (we may need a 1-sentence addendum).
2) Kimberly: can your team sketch the Ariba field mapping change and call out any field name transforms we need to document for the Novus EDI team?
3) Ava: if you can confirm the onboarding cadence (target production date), we can aim to surface the addendum in a single redline pass.

I'll attach a draft Order Form redline with the config clause marked — Jordan / Kimberly, see attached.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redline_OrderForm_Grace_v2.docx, RFQ_Ariba_PO_Field_Spec_0425.xlsx

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-25 13:42 -0700
Subject: Re: Ariba onboarding — PO field clarifications before signature

Grace / Kimberly — quick legal check. I reviewed the Order Form and MSA stack. Recommendation:

- Add a single-sentence configuration clause to the Order Form under Appendix A (billing & invoicing): "Customer may opt into line-level invoicing; enabling line-level invoicing may modify certain acknowledgement SLAs as documented in the service addendum."
- Keep technical details out of the contract; reference a field-mapping artifact maintained by ops (link in a Schedule).

I've proposed language in the attached doc (tracked changes). If Novus insists on putting EDI field names in the contract, escalate to Legal Ops for procurement approval — that adds maintenance overhead.

I'll loop in Legal Ops only if Ava pushes for field-level enumerations. For now, I think the short clause + ops schedule will keep the contract clean and operationally safe.

-Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-04-26 09:18 -0700
Subject: Re: Ariba onboarding — PO field clarifications before signature

Thanks — I've mapped the RFQ fields to our Ariba ingestion pipeline and called out three items that need ops coordination:

1) Field normalization: Novus's "invoice_to_id" will be sent as line-level metadata. We'll need to add a prefix rule to avoid collisions with header-level IDs.
2) Acknowledgement SLA: enabling line-level invoicing changes the validation flow; ops recommends a 99.0% ack within 30s for first 30 days (then revert to standard 99.9% once warmed).
3) Testing: propose a 2-week staging window with a small carrier to validate transforms.

I've uploaded the mapping doc to our shared drive and attached the summary here. Grace / Jordan, if legal is happy with the short clause Jordan suggested, ops will prepare the field-mapping Schedule (link below) and we can bind it at signature.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Integrations — Redwood Inference

Attachment: RFQ_Ariba_PO_Field_Spec_0425.xlsx

- Legal (Jordan) will include the one-sentence addendum in the Order Form.
- Ops (Kimberly) will publish the field-mapping Schedule and run a 2-week staging validation starting 2027-05-10.
- We'll include a short paragraph in the DocuSign envelope noting the optional line-level invoicing config and the temporary ack SLA during warmup.
